nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Mineral Ultra-Light Face Sunscreen Fluid SPF 50

avis.texte: They changed the formula. It stinks so much! ( smells like spoiled milk or stinky feet) So regret that I bought 4 bottles in one time :(

avis.titre: Great sunscreen but not for deeper tones
avis.texte: My dermatologist recommended this for my dry, sensitive skin and i really wanted to love it but it leaves a highly noticeable white cast after application. I have a deeper tan skin tone, so it's the same issue I've had with a lot of other mineral SPFs. Another thing I've noticed is that is the product is liquidy and thin, my skin started burning from the friction of when I rub it in for a bit longer (not from the product but from rubbing it in). But a minor white cast still lasted. But I do love how the smell isn't too strong and how it feels very light and smooth after applying.
Goes on very smooth and it feels very light but it did leave a white cast on my skin. I have medium toned skin. It was very difficult to remove as well .

avis.titre: Goes on well but has a bad odor
avis.texte: Love how this sunscreen goes on my face. It doesn't leave a white film. It has a sour milk odor which is hard to adjust to.

I'd been using this sunscreen for years and loved the texture, finish, and the fact that it was mineral. Many many repurchases, but this round was different. There has absolutely been a BAD reformulation, and now it 1. STINKS to high heaven (chemically dirty feet) and 2. is gritty now, no longer smooth and milky in texture (yes I shook the bottle) and 3. now makes my eyes sting. So sad to lose a HG like this, LRP how could you!

avis.titre: Could not get over the smell!
avis.texte: After doing research on face sunscreen, I thought I would be completely safe buying this product. However, I cannot get over the smell. It smells like spoiled milk, and the scent tends to linger.

This is my first bottle of this sunscreen and I am so glad that I got it. I LOVE IT! Is very liquidy and rubs in so nice and easy makes my skin feel so good and healthy and goes nicely under my makeup im obsessed..I am so surprised it has bad reviews.

This sunscreen had a foul spoiled funky smell. I don't know if I got a bad batch or if they changed their formula becuase I've used this sunscreen for over 10 years and haven't experienced this. I usually buy from the drug store, but decided to order from Ulta this time for the convenience of free shipping. I want to return, but they charge for return shipping and I don't live close enough to an Ulta Store. When I was in Europe, I bought more La Roche-Posey products and I didn't experience that weird smell. Is the formula for USA different than Europe?

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: A very easy product to incorporate into your daily routine. Not greasy, shiny or white. Some skin tones may notice white as I read in prior reviews but that didn't happen in this case.
this caused me to have a flare up where i had bumps that became itchy and also irritating and my skin is struggling to recover. Itd been 2-3 days sincd i first used it.
Feels great in the skin but the smell is awful and it leaves a white cast.

I have fsir skin and this left a white cast on me. I usually put in my sunscreen and let it soak into my skin for 10 minutes and then apply foundation. My skin still had a white cast after 10 minutes. I felt my foundation didn't apply nicely over it either. I returned this product.
I've been using this for years after having skin cancer. It doesn't irritate my skin or cause problems with my roscea and plays well with my skin care products.

avis.titre: Combination skin?  breakout prone?  sensitive? Fair skin?
avis.texte: Combination skin? breakout prone? sensitive? Fair skin? If you answered yes to any of the above this is your new year round sunscreen best friend. This is the fist sunscreen i have been able to use IN MY LIFE on my face without irritation or breakouts. I could see it being "complicated" if you have dark skin..it does have a glow to it which is great for my fair skin may not work on melanin rich friends,.

avis.titre: Good suncreen for acne prone skin
avis.texte: I was hesitant to buy this sunscreen at first given the price and its size (I was used to buying the Cerave sunscreen) but after using this specific Anthelios sunscreen for months, this has become the new sunscreen in my skincare routine. I have acne prone oily skin and this sunscreen doesn't cause me to break out. It has a super light weight feeling on my skin which I love. The texture is more on the liquid side rather than cream side. My only criticism of the product is it's bad smell. It's not too bad but it is quite strong at first, but after a minute or two you get used to it.
The sunsceewm itself is good, my skinnfeels protected and the formula is not greasy. However it leaves a white cast so kinfolk beware

avis.titre: Remarkable results even on the most sensitive skin.

I usually put some Tamanu oil on under it, massage it in and then concealer just where i need it around the mouth and under eyes and look glowing and healthy.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again.

The product easily melted off my face in the hot, humid weather here in Florida. I had to return the product I purchased and got the Supergoop Unseen sunscreen which works beautifully.

Purchased this sunscreen because I figured it would be okay for my sensitive skin. It applies nicely and doesn't sting my face (other sunscreens usually do). I'm fairly light skinned but it left a really bad white cast, pills and is a bit too drying for me.

Nice application, doesn't peel. Great for my sensitive skin but I'll need to apply makeup as you'll see this changed my face color. I would warn against darker skin tones wearing this sunscreen. I didn't get the tinted because I fear it will transfer but I'll have to return for that.
MY sensitive skin was not irritated by this womderful sunscreen. It was nearly invisible on my face. worked well. Hurray.

I tried it under Elf Soft Glam and Elf Hydrating CC cream and it made both look dry and patchy. (I have dry to combo skin.) It looks okay on it's own so I'll use it that way, but I'm really disappointed considering how expensive it is.

avis.titre: Works well for me, not sure it's for everyone though

The formula is creamy and very light. I also have sensory issues so I cannot stand greasy sunscreen, this one feels a bit greasy at first but once you rub it in I doesn't seem to feel like much! Which I super appreciate cause other sunscreens that sometimes don't feel bad when rubbing in end up feeling heavy and sticky :) I will also say I struggle with acne and it burns slightly when it's put over breakouts but it cools down after a few minutes, so it may not be great for very sensitive skin ❤ I find it works well enough for me and compared to others I've tried it's awesome... But I can definitely see how it wouldn't work for some people

This sunscreen is lightweight sunscreen. However it leaves such a bad white cast. The white cast is horrible no matter how much you rub it in.

i've gone through maybe 7 or 8 bottles of this and i will continue to repurchase this. it is a little more on the pricier side but a bottle lasts me 4-5 months so i wouldn't say its too bad. it used to leave a slight white finish but once i figured out how to use it properly, i no longer have any issues with this spf. i have combination skin - a little more on the oily side, and my mom has very oily skin. we are both acne prone and this doesnt break either of us out. this is literally my holy grail and i will neverrrr stop buying this!!
Me gustó muchísimo. Es súper seco y no me doy cuenta que lo tengo puesto durante el día. Lo uso siempre y a mi novio también le gustó para su piel. Lo súper recomiendo.

avis.titre: too pale-- even for fair skin, however...
avis.texte: I'm light skinned, but not the fairest (level 2 neutral). This sunscreen seems like it rubs in clear, but it looks terrible over any dry spots. I can rub it in until it's invisible, but you don't want to do that too much to sunscreen or it won't be effective enough. I also have the tinted version of this sunscreen which is much better, but a bit too dark for me. So I mix a few drops of this white into the tinted for the perfect hue. However, this is an annoying process, so I hope La Roche eventually makes more shades of this product. **THE GOOD:*** the texture is amazing, by far better than many of the older versions of mineral sunscreens. It dries down to a silky finish and doesn't feel sticky, thick, or greasy. I only need to apply a very light amount of finishing powder after. It's not moisturizing, so I do make sure to apply a tiny bit of moisturizer and let it soak in beforehand. If you're super pale or don't have flaky skin, you might love this sunscreen. If you're closer to light-med tone, try the tinted version first.

Those with oily skin - I'm not sure how this would react with your oils, either. My dermatologist recommended this to me once I developed mild Melasma in June 2020. I now use even more of this product to protect my skin!

avis.titre: Excellent chemical-free protection for your face
avis.texte: I love the consistency of this sunscreen. It's really thin and lightweight...and melts right into your skin, leaving a silky smooth finish and great pre-makeup base. There's also no hint of fragrance so you don't feel like you're supposed to be at the beach when wearing it. It's formulated for all skin types (including sensitive skin like mine) and doesn't cause any irritation or redness. It actually feels quite nice on the skin. And I love the packaging - it comes in a cool, slim bottle that easily fits in a small pocket. What I love most about this product is that it's not only more effective as a mineral sunscreen than traditional (non-mineral) ones, but it also doesn't contain any chemicals that absorb into the skin. The two active ingredients (titanium dioxide and zinc oxide) simply provide a barrier on the skin's surface that reflect the sun's damaging rays. There's also a tropical leaf extract included (senna alata) that acts as an antioxidant to help prevent premature aging from the sun. The only downside I would say I experienced with this product was the slight white cast it left on my skin. This is fairly common for mineral sunscreens but due to this, I've decided to limit my wear to days when I'm going to be outside and in direct sunlight. I have a pretty fair complexion as it is and don't need to be making myself any paler when I'm stuck inside most of the day, behind a computer. Perhaps if I wore heavier makeup, I wouldn't notice it as much but next time, I thin

avis.titre: Excellent chemical-free protection for your face
avis.texte: I love the consistency of this sunscreen. It's really thin and lightweight...and melts right into your skin, leaving a silky smooth finish and great pre-makeup base. There's also no hint of fragrance so you don't feel like you're supposed to be at the beach when wearing it. It's formulated for all skin types (including sensitive skin like mine) and doesn't cause any irritation or redness. It actually feels quite nice on the skin. And I love the packaging - it comes in a cool, slim bottle that easily fits in a small pocket. What I love most about this product is that it's not only more effective as a mineral sunscreen than traditional (non-mineral) ones, but it also doesn't contain any chemicals that absorb into the skin. The two active ingredients (titanium dioxide and zinc oxide) simply provide a barrier on the skin's surface that reflect the sun's damaging rays. There's also a tropical leaf extract included (senna alata) that acts as an antioxidant to help prevent premature aging from the sun. The only downside I would say I experienced with this product was the slight white cast it left on my skin. This is fairly common for mineral sunscreens but due to this, I've decided to limit my wear to days when I'm going to be outside and in direct sunlight. I have a pretty fair complexion as it is and don't need to be making myself any paler when I'm stuck inside most of the day, behind a computer.
